Caswell Modern Electronics (CME) browse by type eq/excite/filter/wah filter low-pass filter browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Caswell Modern Electronics (CME) Shark Mouth - Bass Synth Fuzz Published on July 5, 2016 Caswell Modern Electronics (CME) fuzz low-pass filter pedal Information Caswell Modern Electronics The Shark Mouth Bass Synth Fuzz turns your bass signal into sharp Sawtooth wave form giving it loads of sustain and compression, very smooth glissando, and un-compromised subsonic goodness. Powered by the beloved and now discontinued MPSA18 that have been matched with care. The Shark Mouth also features a passive Low Pass Filter control to tame the more harsh edges of the sawtooth sound.
